knowledge_point.title: Finding an Integral Expression for Flux

question.:question/problem:
Consider $\mathbf F(x,y)=\bigl(- 6 x\bigr)\mathbf i+\bigl(4 y\bigr)\mathbf j$ and the circle $C$ given by $x^2+y^2=4.$ The outward flux is written as

$$
\oint_C\boxed{\phantom{x^2y}}\,\mathrm{d}s.
$$

What is the missing expression? Do not evaluate the integral.

*Hint: The outward unit normal is $\mathbf n=\frac{x}{2}\mathbf i+\frac{y}{2}\mathbf j.$*
question.:question/worked-solution:
The integrand is the dot product with the outward **unit** normal. Multiply corresponding components and add.

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mathbf F\cdot\mathbf n&=\bigl(- 6 x\bigr)\frac{x}{2}+\bigl(4 y\bigr)\frac{y}{2}\\
&=\bigl(- 3 x^{2}\bigr)+\bigl(2 y^{2}\bigr)\\
&=- 3 x^{2} + 2 y^{2}.
\end{aligned}
$$

The missing expression is $- 3 x^{2} + 2 y^{2}.$

knowledge_point.title: Finding an Integral Expression for Flux

question.:question/problem:
![](images/5c/5cbd62feddcce7a676a76117de09154da21abdd8b039c0e45a7a0e7d5fb00e9c.png)

Consider $\mathbf F(x,y)=\bigl(- 2 y^{2}\bigr)\mathbf i+\bigl(2 x^{2} y + 2 x\bigr)\mathbf j.$ The rectangle $C$ has right, top, left, and bottom sides $C_1,C_2,C_3,C_4,$ respectively. Write its outward flux in the following order.

$$
\begin{aligned}
\oint_C\mathbf F\cdot\mathbf n\,\mathrm{d}s&=\int_{C_3}g_1\,\mathrm{d}s+\int_{C_4}g_2\,\mathrm{d}s\\
&\quad+\int_{C_2}g_3\,\mathrm{d}s+\int_{C_1}g_4\,\mathrm{d}s.
\end{aligned}
$$

Which ordered quadruple $(g_1,g_2,g_3,g_4)$ gives the four dot products? Leave expressions in terms of $x$ and $y,$ before substituting side equations. Do not evaluate any integral.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The outward normals on the right, top, left, and bottom sides are $\mathbf i,\mathbf j,-\mathbf i,-\mathbf j,$ respectively. Use the order in the supplied decomposition.

$$
\begin{aligned}
g_1&=\mathbf F\cdot(-\mathbf i)=2 y^{2}\qquad\text{(left side)},\\
g_2&=\mathbf F\cdot(-\mathbf j)=- 2 x^{2} y - 2 x\qquad\text{(bottom side)},\\
g_3&=\mathbf F\cdot(\mathbf j)=2 x^{2} y + 2 x\qquad\text{(top side)},\\
g_4&=\mathbf F\cdot(\mathbf i)=- 2 y^{2}\qquad\text{(right side)}.
\end{aligned}
$$

Thus the ordered quadruple is

$$
\begin{aligned}&\bigl(2 y^{2},\ - 2 x^{2} y - 2 x,\\&\quad 2 x^{2} y + 2 x,\ - 2 y^{2}\bigr)\end{aligned}.
$$

These are integrands on different sides; opposite signs alone do not cancel their integrals.

:answer-field/choices.:answer/value: \begin{aligned}&\bigl(- 2 y^{2},\ - 2 x^{2} y - 2 x,\\&\quad 2 x^{2} y + 2 x,\ 2 y^{2}\bigr)\end{aligned}
\begin{aligned}&\bigl(2 x^{2} y + 2 x,\ 2 y^{2},\\&\quad - 2 y^{2},\ - 2 x^{2} y - 2 x\bigr)\end{aligned}
\begin{aligned}&\bigl(- 2 x^{2} y - 2 x,\ - 2 y^{2},\\&\quad 2 y^{2},\ 2 x^{2} y + 2 x\bigr)\end{aligned}
\begin{aligned}&\bigl(2 y^{2},\ 2 x^{2} y + 2 x,\\&\quad - 2 x^{2} y - 2 x,\ - 2 y^{2}\bigr)\end{aligned}
\begin{aligned}&\bigl(2 y^{2},\ - 2 x^{2} y - 2 x,\\&\quad 2 x^{2} y + 2 x,\ - 2 y^{2}\bigr)\end{aligned}

knowledge_point.title: Finding an Integral Expression for Flux

question.:question/problem:
![](images/5c/5cbd62feddcce7a676a76117de09154da21abdd8b039c0e45a7a0e7d5fb00e9c.png)

Consider $\mathbf F(x,y)=\bigl(- 2 y^{2}\bigr)\mathbf i+\bigl(2 x^{2} y + 2 x\bigr)\mathbf j.$ The rectangle $C$ has right, top, left, and bottom sides $C_1,C_2,C_3,C_4,$ respectively. The outward flux across the left side $C_3$ is written as

$$
\int_{C_3}\boxed{\phantom{x^2+y}}\,\mathrm{d}s.
$$

What is the missing expression? Leave expressions in terms of $x$ and $y,$ before substituting side equations. Do not evaluate any integral.
question.:question/worked-solution:
On the left side, outward points left, so $\mathbf n=-\mathbf i.$ The tangent component contributes zero.

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mathbf F\cdot\mathbf n&=(- 2 y^{2})(-1)+(2 x^{2} y + 2 x)(0)\\
&=2 y^{2}.
\end{aligned}
$$

The missing expression is $2 y^{2}.$
